// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1877): images wrapped with withUniwind (the app's real wrapper idiom), none with the prop.
import { Image } from 'react-native';
import { Image as ExpoImage } from 'expo-image';
import { withUniwind } from 'uniwind';
const Pic = withUniwind(Image);
const Wide = withUniwind(ExpoImage, { source: 'src' });
const Photo2 = withUniwind(Pic);
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Pic source={{ uri }} />
      <Wide source={{ uri }} />
      <Photo2 source={{ uri }} />
    </>
  );
}
